quality_highlights.aspect: Status messages — all three are clear, action-oriented, and state the operational consequence on failure
Error messages follow the gold standard: state problem, explain why, give concrete example, link to FAQ

single_file_improvements.issue: All four message fields use theatrical action-hero tone: run-success says 'MISSION COMPLETE!' (all-caps), run-failure says 'encountered unexpected challenges...' (passive, no actionable guidance), run-started has awkward grammar. Matches recurring pattern in smoke-codex.md, smoke-copilot-aoai-apikey.md, dev-hawk.md.

No prerequisites/requirements note at top of guide. Enterprise architects evaluating at-scale adoption need runner requirements (Linux+Docker), authentication requirements (GitHub Apps), and plan requirements upfront. Currently discoverable only by reading the full guide. Opening sentence also uses marketing-speak ('something qualitatively different becomes possible').
